task_description: Replace the existing SHIFT//BREAK project with a new Battle Pets game - a Pet Simulator with campaign side mode. Includes collecting system with 8 zones, pet hatching/equipping, upgrade system, and a Battle Cats-style campaign with 48 levels. MVP has 2 playable zones, 4 pets, 3 enemy types + 1 boss, and full UI in Pet Simulator 1 style.

verification.summary: XML validation passes (92 items, all script classes present). JSON project file valid. All 17 Lua modules have proper structure. All old SHIFT_BREAK files removed. RemoteEvent/Function names consistent between server and client. File is 213KB with full embedded source. Three review iterations performed: v1 found 7 server issues (all fixed), v2 found 5 contract issues (all fixed), v3 found 4 payload mismatches (all fixed).
